newsitem.title: MOLDOVA: Moldovan parliament approves new government.
newsitem.headline: Moldovan parliament approves new government.

text.p: Moldova's parliament voted 74 to 15 on Friday to endorse the government formed by Prime Minister Ion Chubuk after last month's presidential election.

Chubuk told parliament his priorities were to promote economic reforms, curb crime and restore the former Soviet republic's territorial integrity, which is challenged by a pro-Russian separatist movement in the eastern Dnestr region.
His government also aimed to raise industrial production by 11 percent this year, cut the annual inflation rate to about 10 percent and raise the average monthly salary to 215 lei ($47).

The previous government resigned in December after President Petru Lucinshci defeated then prime minister Andrei Sangheli in the presidential election. The new government's mandate lasts only until parliamentary elections due in early 1998.
